flg.title: Flag outcomes
flg.sub: Of the customers asked to pay ahead: how many paid, how many walked away. This is the number that tunes your checkout layers. It only reads: nothing changes by itself.
flg.off: The report is off. Orders placed with an ask are always kept; turn the report on in the card below to also keep every checkout a layer asks, and to read them here.
flg.cut: More flags than the report reads: only the newest are counted. Raise the most flags in the card below.

kpi.lostFoot: {pct}: left the checkout, or the order was cancelled unpaid
kpi.collectedFoot: Of those who paid: {delivered} delivered, {refused} refused at the door

point.d: A layer or way flagged at least {n} times that loses at least {pct} of its customers.
point.off: No share is set, so nothing is pointed out. Set one in the card below if you want the report to point out a layer that loses too many.
point.line: {name}: {lost} of {n} flagged walked away ({pct}). The ask may cost more than it saves — consider asking less or asking fewer people in Orders › Risk rules › Checkout advance.
point.none: No layer is losing that many customers.

checkout.d: Every bag a layer asked to pay ahead, once. Left the checkout: no order from that bag. Ordered without the ask: the bag became an order the layer did not ask for (the details changed).

order.d: Orders asked for an advance after they came in: by the team's "Request advance", by the auto option, or by a risk level.

flg.note: To change a layer, go to Orders › Risk rules › Checkout advance. A layer is never changed by this report.

card.d: Whether the report keeps and reads the flags, how far back, and when it points a layer out.
card.warnLeftPercent: Point out a layer that loses this share (%)
card.warnLeftPercentHelp: 1 to 100. Empty: never pointed out (as shipped).
card.minFlags: Fewest flags on a layer before it is pointed out
card.minFlagsHelp: 1 to 1,000. Keeps a few flags from pointing a layer out.

flg.readOnly: Only someone allowed to change settings can change this.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this meanwhile. The card now shows theirs; change it again if needed.
err.network: No connection. Nothing was saved; try again.
err.other: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved; try again.
